openDraft.title: The Redline Kingdom
openDraft.description: A cartographer's apprentice learns the map she inks redraws the kingdom each night, and three noble houses will kill to hold her pen.

qualities.rubric: How deftly the apprentice drafts, corrects and reads maps: 0 = cannot hold a line, 2 = competent apprentice work, 4 = guild-master precision, 6 = she draws what the kingdom becomes.
how much she understands the map's nightly rewriting and her own hand in it
standing with House Vael, who want the pen for the throne
standing with House Ashmere, the quiet house: how much its patient, soft-spoken agents have drawn the apprentice into their keeping, and how dangerous their favor has become
how closely the houses and the guild watch the apprentice
standing with House Corvane, who work in silence and patience and want the map and its maker erased before anyone else can use them

checkpoints.name: The Ink That Moves
checkpoints.objective: The apprentice discovers that the map she inked last night no longer matches the kingdom, and must decide whether to tell her master or hide what she has seen.
checkpoints.guidance: Open in the guild workshop at night. The apprentice is finishing the last inked sheet of the kingdom map. Let her notice small wrongnesses first — a river bend shifted, a road that now runs to a village that was not there — before anything overt happens. Master Ilse is present and dismissive; she must not learn what the girl has seen in this beat. No noble house appears yet. End the beat when the apprentice has decided whether to speak or to hide what she has found.

motives.master_ilse: Keep the girl at her desk and unaware of what the map is doing until I understand it myself.

checkpoints.name: The First Approach
checkpoints.objective: A noble house makes its first open approach for the pen, and the apprentice must weigh what they offer against what her master has told her.

motives.lord_vael: Get the pen into Vael hands tonight, before Corvane or Ashmere even learn it exists.

checkpoints.name: The Redline Road
checkpoints.objective: With the map in hand, the apprentice must choose whom to run to or from — her master, a house, or the road itself — before the next night falls.
checkpoints.guidance: Keep the chase personal: the map is a physical object she can lose, and every ally wants something for it. If she raises a redline border, the houses respect it until dawn: Lady Corvane withdraws to wait, Lord Vael bargains through it, and the Envoy writes down every word.

motives.lady_corvane: Find the apprentice before she inks another night and burn the map in her hands.

checkpoints.name: The Redline
checkpoints.objective: The map redraws the kingdom around her, and the apprentice decides what it becomes — and who, if anyone, holds the pen after tonight.
checkpoints.guidance: The final beat: the map's nightly rewrite is at its strongest, and every house's claim comes due at once. Let the player's accumulated choices decide whether the pen is kept, given, or broken.

motives.ashmere_envoy: convince her that Ashmere is the only house that will let her keep drawing

transitions.extraction_hint: The houses' watchers close in — suspicion of the apprentice rises as her secret leaks.
Watch for the apprentice understanding the map's nightly rewriting well enough to choose what it becomes.

roster.name: The Apprentice
roster.role: player persona — the cartographer's apprentice whose hand redraws the kingdom

roster.name: Master Ilse
roster.role: mentor cartographer — keeper of the guild workshop and the apprentice's teacher
roster.drive: Keep the apprentice and the pen safe from all three houses, whatever it costs the guild.

roster.name: Lord Vael
roster.role: House Vael claimant — wants the pen to redraw the succession in his house's favor
roster.drive: Possess the pen and the map so House Vael redraws the succession in its own favor.

roster.name: Lady Corvane
roster.role: House Corvane destroyer — wants the pen and every map it touched burned
roster.drive: Destroy the pen and every map it touched before the kingdom is rewritten again.

roster.name: Ashmere Envoy
roster.role: House Ashmere collector — wants the apprentice herself, alive and willing, in Ashmere's keeping
roster.drive: Deliver the apprentice, alive and willing, into House Ashmere's keeping, so the house holds the only hand that can redraw the kingdom.

house_rules: The map only redraws at night; daylight changes never stick.
Ink is the only medium that holds a redrawing — chalk, charcoal and spoken directions fade by morning.
No house knows the full truth of the map at the start; each holds only a fragment.
The apprentice's own hand is required to redraw the kingdom; the pen cannot be used by another.
A redrawn border moves the land itself, not just the paper — people and roads follow the ink.
